name: Conversations
author: Brett
description: A local search index of every conversation with Brett: Claude Code chats, claude.ai exports and the transcribed session recordings, cut into passages, tagged by date, topic and build, with local embeddings (no model, no key, no tokens). Search what was said, find which session it was in, and pull a context pack for an agent. Brett's standing rules and decisions are gathered into a rules ledger that every rules brief (orchestrator dispatches, headless runs) carries. AI answers only behind their switch.
